'''Count Hoisin''' (Japanese: '''オイスター伯爵''' ''Count Oyster'') is recurring character who first appeared in ''[[HZ113|Mega Evolution - Ult]]''. He is a member of the [[Lost Mayo Maze]]. His battling partner is [[Shōyu]].
